item.title: 49ers defensive lineman undergoes surgery after being shot
item.description: San Francisco 49ers defensive lineman Keion White has had surgery after being shot in the ankle. The incident reportedly happened in the early hours of Monday morning. The injury is not considered career or life-threatening while the San Francisco Police Department is yet to make an arrest. Advertisement White had been in Santa Clara to watch his former team - the New England Patriots - play in the Super Bowl.

item.title: Irish women lose to Argentina
item.description: The Irish women's hockey team fell to a 5-nil defeat to Argentina this morning. That was in the second phase of the FIH Hockey Pro League in Australia. Next up is a meeting with the hosts on Thursday. Advertisement

item.title: Liverpool defender yet to train with squad
item.description: Manager Arne Slot has revealed this morning that Liverpool defender Joe Gomez had yet to train with the squad. The Reds boss expected him to join in today's session as he recovers from a hip issue. Gomez could be an option at right-back tomorrow away to Sunderland. Advertisement Jeremie Frimpong and Conor Bradley are injured while Dominic Szoboszlai is suspended after his red card against Manchester City. = Bayern Munich are having "intensive talks" with Harry Kane about his future. item.title: Republic of Ireland to face Qatar and Canada
item.description: The Republic of Ireland will face Qatar and tournament co-hosts Canada in pre-World Cup friendlies later this year. Heimir Hallgrimsson's side will welcome Qatar to the Aviva Stadium on May 28th, before taking on the Canadians in Montreal nine days later. The Boys in Green first to have clear the qualifier play-offs next month, taking on Czechia in the semi-final in Prague. Advertisement

item.title: Appeals board refuses planning retention to business whose directors include Cllr Johnny Healy-Rae
item.description: The planning appeals board has refused to grant planning retention to a business whose directors include Cllr Johnny Healy-Rae. An Taisce appealed to An Coimisiún Pleanála after Kerry County Council granted planning retention to Sunville Construction Ltd to continue operating a quarry at Rossacroo Wood near Kilgarvan. Kerry County Council had granted retention permission to retain a previously quarried area of 2.2 hectares, equating to more than five acres, at Rossacroo Wood, Crohane, Clonkeen.

item.title: Just over 750 social homes delivered in Kerry since 2022
item.description: Just over 750 new social homes were delivered in Kerry over a three-year period. That’s according to information provided by the Housing Minister, James Browne. Between 2022 and September 2025, 757 new build social homes have been delivered in the county. item.title: Walking trail in Killarney National Park closed for maintenance
item.description: A walking trail in Killarney National Park is closed this week for maintenance. Conservation rangers are advising that The Arthur Young Trail along Muckross Peninsula, particularly the Dinis Trail exit, is closed. Killarney National Park rangers say the trail will reopen on Saturday. Advertisement
